name: Almost Heaven Himalaya Corner 6-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Himalaya Corner 6-Person Indoor Sauna The Himalaya Series, by Almost Heaven Saunas, enhances the traditional sauna experience by introducing Himalayan Salt to your sauna sessions. Proponents of salt therapy claim that exposure to passive Himalayan salt improves respiratory function, enhances skin hydration, and reduces stress, further enhancing the sauna experience. The Himalayan Series incorporates a full wall of Himalayan pink salt that is backlit with lighting, including color choices to fit your mood. Whether your goal is to benefit from the salt experience or simply enjoy the ambiance provided by the back-lit salt wall, you will love the Himalaya Sauna experience! The Himalaya Corner 6-person indoor sauna provides multi-level seating, with stylish back supports for the upper and lower benches. The Himalaya Corner unit is spacious enough for six people, and the bench configurations allow you to sit, recline, or lie down in complete comfort. The 8kw heater delivers exceptional heat to the sauna and allows you to enjoy sauna temperatures of up to 190°F. The Himalaya Corner 6-person indoor sauna is constructed from smooth-grain Nordic spruce lumber with horizontal and vertical board designs that will beautifully accent your home decor. Features High-grade smooth-grain Nordic spruce Tongue-and-groove construction: 1-3/8” finished thickness Horizontal and vertical wood wall sections Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Pre-assembled wall sections, roof sections, benches, and backrests Utilizes the existing floor. Suitable options include concrete, ceramic, vinyl, laminate, or tile flooring (carpet not recommended) Tempered glass door and windows Built-in vent with sliding cover Himalayan pink salt rear wall Back-lit lighting on the salt wall with multi-color choices Hand-held remote to change lighting functions Three benches with multi-level seating Indoor usage Corner placement design Hand-crafted construction Best-in-class 8kw heater & sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Hand-crafted workmanship Specifications Seats up to six people Indoor usage Heater size: 8kw, 240V, 40-amp requirement, hard-wire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Hand-held remote for lighting operation Exterior dimensions: 81"W x 81”D x 80”H Interior dimensions: 78”W x 78”D x 78” Lower bench size: 57”L x 24”W x 18”H Upper bench size: 78”L x 24”W x 36”H Upper bench L extension Size: 57”L x 24”W x 36”H 1-1/2” thick element wall and roof sections 5/16” thick tempered door and window glass Handcrafted construction Door can be assembled to swing right or left Upper bench can be assembled with L on the left or right Shipping weight: 1250 lbs Note: All dimensions are approximate Options & Customizations Lumber: The Himalaya Corner 6-person indoor sauna is constructed using thick Nordic Spruce pieces of lumber. This sturdy lumber is perfect for a free-standing sauna and offers plenty of natural insulation. Heater: You can upgrade the Himalaya Corner sauna from a standard 8kW Wall Heater to a Virta deluxe heater! Specific models are also available with WIFI options. Care & Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Read more about long-term care and maintenance here. Shipping & Assembly The Himalaya Corner 6-person indoor sauna will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. See the shipping tab for more details. Mid-level handyman and assembly skills are recommended for this sauna. Minimal sawing or modifying certain components may be necessary during the assembly process. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6-8 hours. It is recommended that you review the installation manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Resources Himalaya Corner Installation and Owner's Manual Videos
